source: Natural Earth 1:50m: Admin 0 Countries and Admin 0 Boundary Lines (land) (Cultural Vectors), Coastline (Physical Vectors). Public domain, https://www.naturalearthdata.com. GeoJSON from github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector (master, VERSION 5.2.0-pre), fetched 18 Nov 2026.
processing: Douglas-Peucker simplified: 0.03 deg where a line or ring touches South America / the Caribbean (lon -100..-20, lat -60..32), 0.16 deg elsewhere (rings under 0.05 sq deg dropped there); Brazil 0.03 deg, Singapore 0.004 deg. Coordinates in 1/100 deg integers, each line or ring one string: lon/lat deltas zigzag-encoded in Google's encoded-polyline alphabet (decoder in src/scenes/_brazil-geo.js). label = Natural Earth LABEL_X / LABEL_Y.
